waypoints.name: North Lake (Piute Pass) Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From US 395 in Bishop, drive west on West Line Street (Highway 168) about 18 miles and turn right onto North Lake Road, a steep, narrow dirt road. At about 1.6 miles turn right into the hiker parking lot near the pack station, then walk about 0.6 mile up the road to the trailhead at the far end of North Lake Campground. A wilderness permit is required for overnight trips.

waypoints.name: Mount Humphreys
waypoints.directions: Take the Piute Pass Trail past Loch Leven to Piute Pass, then leave the trail and go cross-country northwest across Humphreys Basin to the highest Humphreys Lake. Climb the southwest slope, most easily by the wide chute on its far left, to the broad gully that slants up and left to the notch northwest of the summit, then finish up the northwest face, with about 100 feet of easy class 4 below the top.
